STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rippleCarryAdder_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rippleCarryAdder_combined.v · Open raw
module fullAdder(a, b, cin, cout, s);
	input a;
	input b;
	input cin;
	output cout;
	output s;
	
	assign cout = (a & b) | (a & cin) | (b & cin);
	assign s = (a ^ b ^ cin);
endmodule

module rippleCarryAdder(A, B, cin, s, cout);
	input [3:0] A;
	input [3:0] B;
	input cin;
	output [3:0] s;
	output cout;
	
	wire c1;
	wire c2;
	wire c3;
	
	fullAdder add(
		.a(A[0]),
		.b(B[0]),
		.cin(cin),
		.cout(c1),
		.s(s[0])
	);
	fullAdder add1(
		.a(A[1]),
		.b(B[1]),
		.cin(c1),
		.cout(c2),
		.s(s[1])
	);
	fullAdder add2(
		.a(A[2]),
		.b(B[2]),
		.cin(c2),
		.cout(c3),
		.s(s[2])
	);
	fullAdder add3(
		.a(A[3]),
		.b(B[3]),
		.cin(c3),
		.cout(cout),
		.s(s[3])
	);
endmodule
